notes: the two «ح» branches meet at حيوة بن شريح; the names after the last «ح» (إسحاق ... ابن عمر) are written once and so belong to both branches
«- قال سليمان عن أبي عبد الرحمن الخراساني، -» is Abu Dawud's remark on another version, naming a different transmitter in إسحاق's place: the variant group, not a route
«قال أبو داود الإخبار لجعفر» says the wording is Jafar's branch
the Companion ابن عمر ends the chain; the Prophet is not a link
